title: Persist restored CMS workflows through an injectable backend
description: Verify the actual restored CMS component paths. Add typed injectable persistence boundaries with an isolated local fixture backend, optimistic concurrency and failure handling. Keep live Amplify/auth and production data disconnected. Inventory every module integration and report exact remaining cloud requirements.
